name: SZp / fZ-light Compressor (experimental reference)
description: QUARANTINED experimental/reference compressor (not a supported composable module; absent from the umbrella header, stage catalog, and fusion planner). Independent GPU implementation of the SZp block-local predict, quantize, and fixed-width pack pipeline; FZM payload not byte-compatible with the upstream container. StageType::SZP factory stays linked for archive back-compat. Supported equivalent: examples/presets/szp_composed.toml.

paper.title: fZ-light: A Fast and Light Scientific Lossy Compression Framework toward Optimizing High-Performance Computing Applications
paper.authors: Jiajun Huang, Sheng Di, et al.
